lines.t:
An <c:ffff00>attack<c> that hits the weak point of an {{opponent}}'s
{{part}}.
A {{critical}} hit deals <c:ffff00>{{damage}}<c> ignoring the {{opponent}}'s
<c:ffff00>Defense Power<c>.
The higher the attack's <c:ffff00>{{success_power}}<c>, the likelier
it is.
An attack <c:ffff00>taken<c> while <c:ffff00>unable to defend<c> and <c:ffff00>unable<c>
<c:ffff00>to evade<c> is always {{critical}}.
